artworks.title: Ernest of Holstein, Schawenburg and Sternberg, Prince of Holy Roman Empire
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in elaborate armor within an ornate oval frame. He has short, curly hair, a moustache, and a pointed goatee. The background features classical elements and the frame includes inscriptions and decorative motifs. The style indicates a baroque influence.

artworks.title: Thomas Cromwell, Earl of Essex
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length engraving of a man identified as Thomas Cromwell, looking to the left. He is seated in a side profile position with his arms crossed in front of him. The man has a solemn expression with defined features, including a pronounced nose and deep-set eyes. His hair is short and light-colored, peeking out from under a cap. He is dressed in a coat with a wide, luxurious fur collar. In front of him on the table are papers and a quill. The background is plain with a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Thomas Cromwell, Earl of Essex
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is seated in a three-quarter position, facing to the right side of the image. His facial features are finely detailed, with distinct eyes and a lightly pursed mouth. His hair is straight and appears to be shoulder-length, though it is mostly covered by a soft, rounded hat. He is wearing a heavy, fur-lined coat with elaborately layered clothing underneath. His arms are crossed in front of him on a table, where several folded documents and a small object are visible. The backdrop is a plain, vertically striped wall. Lettering under the engraved image describes the subject as "THOMAS CROMWELIVS" among other Latin text. The portrait is printed on an aged piece of paper, with some visible wear around the edges.

artworks.title: Walter Devereux, First Earl of Essex
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to his right, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a neat mustache and beard, short hair, and is wearing an ornate hat with a large feather. He is dressed in noble attire with a high ruffled collar, armor with intricate detailing, and a medallion or pendant around his neck. The background is a dark oval frame with text surrounding the image. The engraving highlights the details of his attire and features.

artworks.title: Walter Devereux, First Earl of Essex
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a man portrayed from the waist up, facing slightly to the right. He has a beard, mustache, styled hair with a wave, and wears a decorative hat with a feather. He is dressed in elaborate clothing including a cuirass, a ruffled collar, a draped fabric over his shoulder, and a medallion on a chain around his neck. The background features a textured oval vignette with Latin text, surrounded by a plain paper border showing some discoloration.

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, Second Earl of Essex
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of an individual from the chest up, facing forward with their head slightly turned to the left. The person has prominent facial features with a strong jawline, a well-groomed beard, and mustache. Their hair is curly and covered by a wide-brimmed hat with feathers. They have a neutral expression and wear elaborate armor with intricate detailing. The background features engraved lines for texture and an inscribed oval frame with text. Handwriting in a script style is visible in the lower section of the image.

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, Second Earl of Essex
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting the upper half of a man's body. The man, identified as Robertus Deverex, is facing slightly to his right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has long curly hair, a full beard, and a serious expression. He is wearing armor with a sash across his chest. No jewelry is visible. The portrait is in an oval frame with his name inscribed. Below the image, there is Latin text inscribed. The background has a cross-hatched pattern. The portrait is centered on aged paper with a rough edge on the left side.

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, Second Earl of Essex
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of a man wearing armor. The man has strong, defined features including deeply set eyes and a broad nose. He has voluminous wavy hair, a full beard, and a mustache. He is wearing detailed armor with rivets and embossed patterns, as well as a fabric sash across his chest. Surrounding the portrait is an oval border with Latin text, and there are closely spaced horizontal lines in the background. Additional Latin text is visible at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, Second Earl of Essex
artworks.description: The image displays a man on horseback in an authoritative posture. He sits upright with one hand on the reins and the other on his thigh. The man has a bearded face with a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with feathers, engraved armor on his chest, gauntlets, a sash, a cape, and a sheath for a sword on his hip. Additionally, the scene includes a crest and an ornamental cartouche with a written declaration. The background shows clouds, a harbor with ships, and a distant cityscape or fortification.

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, Earl of Essex
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man shown from the waist up, seated and facing slightly to his right. He has distinct facial features, including a prominent beard and mustache, and curly hair that frames his face. The man's left hand rests on his waist. He is wearing a richly patterned garment with an elaborate lace ruff around his neck, a cloak or mantle draped over his shoulders, and a sword at his waist. The background is plain, and the image is bordered by a wide expanse of lightly speckled or foxed paper.

artworks.title: Isabella d'Este
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting, with her body slightly angled to the left. She has an oval face, arched eyebrows, and full lips. Her hair is voluminous and curly, styled in a complex way with tightly coiled ringlets framing her face and extending upward, topped with an ornate jeweled ornament. She wears a textured dress with intricate embroidery on the sleeves, ruffled lace at the cuffs and neck, and a fur stole draped over her shoulders. She holds a fan in her lap with both hands. She wears drop earrings and the background consists of a detailed curtain, possibly made of heavy fabric.

artworks.title: William Estius, Catholic Priest
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the waist upwards. He is positioned facing slightly to his left, with his left hand visible, holding a book. The man's facial features are quite detailed, showing an older face with pronounced cheekbones and a solemn expression. His hair appears to be receding and is covered by a distinct headpiece with a pointed top. He is dressed in a voluminous cloak that is folded around his shoulders. The background is a simple, patterned texture with a small coat of arms in the upper right corner that includes the phrase "Soli Deo Gloria." The text below the portrait reads "GVILIELMVS ESTIVS."

artworks.title: Gabrielle D'Estrees, Marquise de Monceaux
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a woman from the waist up, looking slightly to the right. She has an oval face with delicate features, a high forehead, and symmetrical eyebrows. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo. The woman wears a detailed dress with a lace ruff collar, embroidered patterns, puffed sleeves, pearls around her neck, and a star-shaped brooch on her chest. She also wears a small earring. The background features a circular border with the text "GABRIELLE DESTREES DE MONTCEAUX" and textured areas for depth. There is also cursive script in the foundation of the image.

artworks.title: Gabrielle D'Estrees, Marquise de Montceaux
artworks.description: The image features an upper-body portrait of a woman in an oval frame. She has elaborate high-set hair, a narrow chin, high forehead, slender eyebrows, and a neutral expression. She wears an opulent gown with a large lace ruff collar, a beaded necklace with a pendant, and dangling earrings. The oval frame is adorned with floral motifs, and the name "GABRIELLE DESTREZ MARESCHALLE DE MONCEAVX" is inscribed within it. The background is filled with floral engravings, and there is French text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Alexander Farnese, Duke of Parma
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the torso up, centered within a circular frame. The man is facing slightly to the right with a serious expression. He has sharp facial features, a prominent nose, high cheekbones, a well-groomed beard, and mustache. His hair is short and wavy. The man is clothed in ornate historical attire, including a high ruffled collar, detailed embroidery or embellishments on dark fabric. He holds a staff-like object. He wears a chain with a medallion and stands against a textured background. The circular frame contains an inscription in Latin identifying him as Alexander Farnese.

artworks.title: Alexander Farnese, Duke of Parma
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode II after Otto van Veen
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bust-length portrait in a three-quarter view, facing slightly left. The man has a beard, mustache, short hair swept back, and is wearing detailed, collared attire with a ruffled collar peeking over a dark garment. He holds a baton over his shoulder with one visible hand. In the background, there is an archway and a floral design with long leaves and blossoms. The setting is enclosed in an oval border with an inscription in Latin below the portrait.

artworks.title: Alexander Farnese, Duke of Parma
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man within an ornate oval frame. The man faces slightly right, holding a lightning bolt in his right hand and his left hand on a shield with an illustration. He has a beard, mustache, and styled hair. His attire includes a ruffled collar and detailed garment with patterns. Around the frame are mythological figures and motifs like a laurel wreath. The background inside the frame is starry. The lower part of the image includes an inscribed pedestal.

artworks.title: Johan Faulhaber, Mathematician
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a man facing the viewer. He has a receding hairline, short hair on the sides, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His features include a broad forehead, a pronounced brow, and a focused gaze. The man wears a dark, buttoned-up garment with a wide white collar. His right hand rests on a flat surface, holding measuring instruments, possibly compasses, with geometric shapes drawn on the surface. The background has a textured pattern within an oval border centered in a rectangular frame.

artworks.title: Ferdinand I, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated in a formal pose. His head is turned slightly to his left, with a contemplative expression. The man has a prominent nose, a neatly groomed beard, and expressive eyes. He has a full head of hair styled into waves, with touches of gray. He is dressed in elaborate noble clothing, including a patterned doublet, puffed sleeves, and a fur-trimmed cape. He wears a large decorative chain around his neck and a wide-brimmed hat with a jewel-studded band. His hands are positioned near his chest, with one hand partially visible. The background features a circular frame surrounding the portrait, with ornate Latin inscriptions outside the frame.

artworks.title: Ferdinand I, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up, framed within an oval border. He faces the viewer with his head slightly angled to the left. The man has a furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, a full beard, and a mustache. His hair is wavy, extending to ear length and mostly covered by a hat. The hat is round with a brim, typical of European styles from earlier centuries. He wears a garment with a fur collar and a chain of office or order around his neck. The chain has decorative crosses and insignia. The background inside the oval has a textured pattern, and there are inscriptions around it, including the name "CHRISTO-DUCE" and other Latin text. Below the oval, there are additional inscriptions in Latin, possibly forming a poem or dedication.

artworks.title: Ferdinand I of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a three-quarter-length portrait. His right hand rests on his hip, and his left hand is partially obscured by scrollwork. The man has long, wavy hair, sharp facial features, and an intense gaze. He wears elaborate armor with a breastplate, cuffs, a cloak, and a cravat. A helmet with a plume is placed behind him. The background includes a column and a cloudy sky. Below the man, there is decorative scrollwork with text and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Ferdinand II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person with short, curly hair and distinctive facial features. The individual is dressed in ornate clothing with a ruffled collar and a decorated garment. They are wearing jewelry and holding a small book. The background is an engraving with classical elements, pillars, and mythical figures. It is bordered by decorative motifs, Latin inscriptions, and symbolic designs.

artworks.title: Ferdinand II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate portrait engraving of a man in an oval frame. The man has a serious expression, a beard, and wavy, shoulder-length hair. He is wearing a formal garment with a high collar. Surrounding the portrait are various allegorical figures, cherubs, classical figures of women, and ornate architectural elements with Latin inscriptions. At the top is a coat of arms with wings, a sword, and text banners. Plaques with inscriptions are at the bottom, surrounded by scrollwork. The background is decorated with clouds, architecture, and symbolic elements.

artworks.title: Ferdinand II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image depicts a half-length portrait of a man facing slightly to his left. He has a mustache, a small goatee, and hair swept back from his forehead. He is wearing an elaborate vest with floral patterns and a high-necked, ruffled lace collar typical of the era. The man has a composed expression with a slight smile. He is framed by an oval decorative border with surrounding text, ornamental designs, and a Latin inscription. The background inside the oval is detailed with intricate line work.
